Welcome to Tzion Breslov. An Everflowing Wellspring of spiritual life. Rabbi David Kalmus’ wisdom will inspire you to live your best life.

main:
A New Path Never Before Traveled.

It’s a Very Old Path.

And Yet, it’s Completely New.

Welcome to Tzion Breslov.
An Everflowing Wellspring of spiritual life.

ENRICH YOUR LIFE

Purpose gives meaning to every step.

You’re human. And at your core you carry the spirit of humanity.
The spirit that craves life, love and laughter.
And an insatiable thirst for joy, passion and purpose.

Hi. I’m Rabbi David Yisrael Kalmus.

I spent most of my adolescence and young adulthood thinking there was no inherent meaning to life, no real purpose to the challenges which confront us throughout our lifetime. Until I stumbled upon something that led me on an unlikely journey from despair and angst to unbridled joy and satisfaction.

My story is a dramatic one. I grew up completely secular and fluctuated between crippling bouts of depression and anxiety for years. Discovering my spiritual roots at the age of 24 surprisingly didn’t provide the happiness and inner peace I yearned for. I fell into a major depression and was stuck there for three years straight. Desperate to save myself, I tried every form of therapy out there, electric shock therapy included.

Results? None. I hit rock bottom.

Today, I’m enjoying every breath of life.

Read my full story

G-d loves you.

He wants you to be you. To seek joy. To choose life.

But sometimes life loses its luster.
You’re trying the best you know how.

But you’re not feeling that joie de vivre, that spark, that fire.

You may wonder, is it even possible to break free from the monotony and feel alive again?

Yes it is!

Have you ever heard of Likutei Moharan?

Rebbe Nachman of Breslov’s teachings were intended to resonate with people from all walks of life.
Including you – the seeker, the adventurer, the one who craves purpose.
Written over 200 years ago. Relevant now, more than ever before.

A bit of background: Rebbe Nachman was a spiritual leader and Chassidic master who lived in the 18th century. As novel as they are profound, Rebbe Nachman’s universal teachings are compiled into an ancient text known as ‘Likutei Moharan’.

Welcome to Tzion Breslov

A family on a quest for spiritual connection.

We believe in the incredible power of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov’s teachings and the unique meditation practice he encouraged to ignite a deep, personal transformation within you. Likutei Moharan has been a life-changing discovery for myself and countless others.
My mission is to share what I’ve learnt and inspire others to live their highest version of life.
We’re all about spreading joy, love, and light.

Let’s make the most out of this beautiful life together!

WHAT IS MEDITATION?

Meditation is having a major moment!

From health gurus to professional athletes, creative artists to successful entrepreneurs, everyone is raving about the incredible perks of taking a few moments each day to hush our racing minds and tap into a deeper place of being.

Meditation can help you conquer stress, amplify your concentration, and infuse your daily routine with more serenity, life-force, and insight.

Rebbe Nachman recognized the unprecedented power of mindfulness over two hundred years ago!

Rebbe Nachman champions a unique meditative practice called Hitbodedut, a private, secluded meditation whereby one speaks in his or her own language to the Source of Existence, pouring forth everything that is in one’s heart, as if speaking to one’s best friend.

Rebbe Nachman explains that of all meditative practices, Hitbodedut is the most practical and profound of all.

And the best part, you don’t need any prior training or financial investment.

Simply find a place where you are completely alone, open your mouth, and speak out YOUR truth!

When one practices this unique form of meditation called Hitbodedut consistently and on a daily basis, he or she will begin to find a level of inner joy, quiet confidence, and a settling of the mind and heart which had never been accessible prior.

HELP SPREAD MORE JOY

“A whole new level”

I have been learning Rebbe Nachman’s teachings for years before being exposed to Rabbi Kalmus. And I can honestly say that within a few months of listening to Rabbi Kalmus’s classes, my perception of Rebbe Nachman’s teachings, the Torah, and Hashem is on a whole new level. So
much so that it’s almost hard to even relate to my previous consciousness.

Shalom

“I’m finding the right tools”

With Rebbe Nachman’s teachings, as delivered amazingly by Rabbi Kalmus, I have begun to find more happiness notwithstanding all of the challenges I face, and perhaps more importantly, I feel like I am acquiring the necessary tools to find Hashem in the very challenges themself.

Fed

Classes for all those seeking growth

TRUTH

HOPE

INSPIRATION

JOY

GUIDANCE

CONFIDENCE

WISDOM

CLARITY

Whether you’re searching for greater joy, seeking more meaning in life, or simply curious, we’re here to walk the journey with you.

Remember: Happiness is yours for the taking. You just have to grab it!

“Always remember. Joy is not incidental to the spiritual quest. Its vital.”
– Rebbe Nachman of Breslov

Taste a class

Tell me more about ‘Likutei Moharan’

It is the monumental work of a spiritual giant.
One who believed in the inherent goodness of man.

The great Rebbe Nachman of Breslov, whose teachings are so potent and relevant, they empower even those who don’t believe they are worthy of it.

And they had you in mind.

It doesn’t matter where you are on your spiritual journey. Rabbi Nachman’s teachings will meet you precisely where you’re at. Whether you’re a fresh beginner or a seasoned veteran, Rebbe Nachman has the uncanny pulse and innate wisdom to speak on the very place and circumstances you currently find yourself in .

His classic works are for the scholar, the novice, the non-conformist, the skeptic, the mystic, the dreamer, the professional, and everyone in between.

They uplift. They inspire. They encourage.

The lessons are beautifully written with a luring simplicity that captures the human soul.
Almost like music, with a gentle lilt and placid rhythm. Each word makes you thirsty for more. Each sentence awakening you to live life to its absolute fullest. Each lesson another step towards unconditional joy and well-being.

Who in this world doesn’t want to feel happier?

“I found a tonic for my soul”

Where do I start? I “bumped” into Rav David’s videos at a really hard time in my life. I started listening and just couldn’t get enough. For the first time ever, I found a tonic for my soul. With every class, I found myself comforted in ways I can’t even explain. It wasn’t just the content.
The purity, the empathy, the raw sincerity, the “I’m in it with you” feeling of someone gets me. Someone understands. And now I have a reference point for someone who’s gone through immense, intricate suffering and hasn’t just “made it”, but is soaring!

Chaya

“I’m a new person”

The first time I heard a class by Rav David Yisrael Kalmus, I was at one of the lowest points of my life. I had already given up on faith of any kind and the blackboard of my life looked pretty much empty.
Rabbi Kalmus presents an honest and graspable approach to life through the lens of Rebbe Nachman’s Torah. I discovered a new relationship between my self and my Self. But even more surprising to me, I’m in a “new, yet not new” relationship with my Creator.

Bracha

“Words don’t suffice to express the impact”

Words don’t suffice to express the impact that Tzion Breslov and Rabbi Kalmus have had on my health, purpose, and clarity in life. Their lessons, beautifully weaving Torah concepts from Tanach, Kabbalah and Chassidut are put forward in a clear and sensitive way for people of all backgrounds, covering themes that are most important for us in our times.

Zach

Not just a class. It’s a call to your innermost being.

Faith, wisdom, hope and inspiration await.

Online classes

Choose from an array of over 500 online videos. Short, easy-listening and captivating.

Global Chabura

Powerful stories based on Kabbalah and Chassidus are posted on our Youtube Channel weekly.

in-person classes

In-person classes give you the added benefit of being able to participate live, to ask questions and to receive answers in real time.

Whatsapp groups

Learn and discuss Rebbe Nachman’s teachings with like-minded friends who share the same goal – living an authentic life full of meaning & excitement.

AUDIO classes

Listen anytime, anywhere. These classes are insightful, inspirational, and full of practical advice.

Embrace your authentic self, find joy in your unique journey and watch your faith deepen.

“You must constantly search for the good in others, and all the more so, within yourself.”
– Rebbe Nachman of Breslov

Try a lesson

Short on time? No worries, it’s only 3 minutes!

Without purpose, life is just a series of events.

Dear Brothers and Sisters,

Tzion Breslov is a family.

A fraternity where there exists only unconditional love and respect.

For being YOU. For seeking JOY. For choosing LIFE.

We wish you nothing but the brightest and happiest days ahead.

You deserve to live an incredible life!

“Work at not needing approval from anyone, and you will be free to be who you really are.”
– Rebbe Nachman of Breslov

“It transformed my relationships”

Rav David’s classes have had a massive impact on my life for the good. It’s changed my relationship with people and most importantly changed my relationship with G-d. These teachings have brought me hope, inspiration, and an unprecedented degree of peace. I have no doubt that the perspective these classes bring have the potential to bring people from pits of despair to immense joy, mend relationships, and even save lives.

Alex

Rebbe Nachman’s teachings have been around for centuries but they essentially remained a closed treasure due to their intense depth, scholarship, creativity, and unfounded stigma. It has proven a difficult task to unearth this hidden treasure and share it in a relatable and easily understood way with others.

Tzion Breslov seeks to fill that void and is bringing Rebbe Nachman’s teachings to life. With over 500 teaching resources, Rabbi Kalmus has already reached
thousands of students whose lives have been transformed for the better.

Help us shine out more hope, more love, more light. Each person deserves more!
